_provenance: Recorded 2026-10-17 on a throwaway, unclaimed Plex Media Server 1.42.2.10156-f737b826c (plexinc/pms-docker) on the test host, over loopback with its .LocalAdminToken. Item 1 is a real Dolby Vision profile 5 release (Predator: Killer of Killers (2025) 2160p WEB-DL DV P5, its first 40 s cut with -c copy -strict unofficial so the DOVI record stays, remuxed +faststart), item 2 a generated 1080p 10-bit HEVC control. `items` holds each item's Media as that server analysed it. `decisions` holds GET /video/:/transcode/universal/decision answers: Plex for Android's shape with and without hasMDE (with MDE the server decides no direct play at all), and Samsung's profile with an app-style add-direct-play-profile for mp4/hevc, without and with Plex for Android's add-limitation(scope=videoCodec&scopeName=hevc&type=notMatch&name=video.DOVIProfile&value=5) (the app's own spelling, notMatch) and the PascalCase NotMatch.

Metadata.summary: While three of the fiercest warriors in human history—a Viking raider, a ninja in feudal Japan, and a WWII pilot—are killers in their own right, they are merely prey for their new opponent: the ultimate killer of killers.
Metadata.title: Predator: Killer of Killers

CommonSenseMedia.oneLiner: Bloody, nonstop violence, death in animated alien film.

She then sets out on a relentless quest to reclaim her friend, finding in the end that her quest exacts a far greater price than she had ever imagined.
